sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: Find the volume of a cylinder of radius 5 and height 3. Leave π in the answer where it appears.
Describe the cross-section formed by a cone cut by a plane parallel to its base.
A solid object has mass 4 g and volume 2 cm³. Find its density, and state whether it would float in water (density 1 g/cm³).
A square patio of side 4 m is to be paved at $9 per square metre. Find the total cost, and state which quantity the cost is proportional to.
choices: $144; the cost is proportional to the side length
$144; the cost is proportional to the area
$144; the cost is proportional to the perimeter
$36; the cost is proportional to the area

items.prompt: Find the volume of a cone of radius 10 and height 9. Leave π in the answer where it appears.
Describe the cross-section formed by a sphere cut by any plane that meets it in more than one point.
A solid object has mass 150 g and volume 25 cm³. Find its density, and state whether it would float in water (density 1 g/cm³).
A square patio of side 3 m is to be paved at $25 per square metre. Find the total cost, and state which quantity the cost is proportional to.
choices: $225; the cost is proportional to the area
$75; the cost is proportional to the area
$300; the cost is proportional to the perimeter
$225; the cost is proportional to the side length
